reviews.author: David J.

reviews.title: A complete solution for streamers and gamers
reviews.comment: The RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone measures 8.25" x 7.35" x 3.6" and weighs 1.08 pounds. Included in the box with this RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone is a swing mount, headphone extension cabling, and a USB cable. What's also included is Rode Unify software. When I first purchased the RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone 6 months ago there was no version of this software for Mac. There is now a beta version of Rode Unify software so the device should work fine on both platforms. I have used this RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone for dozens of meetings, a couple of test streams, and recording audio for work and personal interests. Whatever I threw at this RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone it handled admirably. While you can get some dynamic mics that better isolate directional sound, if you need to work with another person to capture their audio as well then this RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone has an edge. There's also the added benefit of dedicated software from the hardware manufacturer. While you can certainly use other pieces of software, what makes the RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone a complete solution is that it comes with the mic, all hardware accessories needed in-the-box and dedicated software. What I liked most about this RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone was: - It was a complete solution for my needs - This mic sounded better than the other condenser mics I owned - The software experience was intuitive and is now available on Mac What I liked least about this RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone was: - It took a few months after purchase to get a beta version of Unify software on Mac - The included mic stand is not the most premium one you'll ever use Overall, if you are in the market for a one-box solution for online meetings, podcasting, voiceovers, streaming or the like then this RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone should be on your shortlist. This RØDE X XCM-50 Professional USB Condenser Microphone comes with all the hardware needed to start podcasting/streaming right away plus the Rode Unify software helps deepen your experience. While the mic stand leaves a bit to be desired and macOS users had to wait just to get a beta release of the Unify Software the value of the entirety of this package is undeniable. 4.0 out of 5.0

reviews.title: Sounds surprisingly good
reviews.comment: I review microphones and I am also a audio enthusiast and I wasn't really expecting to like this little USB microphone that much but I'm going to tell you what,  it sounds quite decent, has some great features and I'm pretty sure your average person would be more than happy with this, it's so much better than what I was expecting.  It may not give you professional quality sound but it'll get you pretty darn close,  I wouldn't try and use it for a voice acting gig or record professional music with it but you can do a professional YouTube channel or a professional podcast or anything like that and this would be a great choice for somebody looking for a USB microphone
